title: The fulness of the godhead

lines.text: The fulness of the Godhead bodily
And we are complete in Him.
Its not by works of righteousness
That we are complete in Him.
Theres nothing more that I can do
And we are complete in Him.

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The fulness of the Godhead bodily
Dwelleth in my Lord (3)
And we are complete in Him.

[Chorus]
Complete, complete, complete in Him,
We are complete in Him (2)

[Verse 2]
Its not by works of righteousness
But by His grace alone (3)
That we are complete in Him.

[Verse 3]
Theres nothing more that I can do
For Jesus did it all (3)
And we are complete in Him.
